verses.text: [“]My spirit is broken; my days are extinguished; the grave awaits me.

xrefs.text: I said, “In the prime of my life I must go through the gates of Sheol and be deprived of the remainder of my years.”
For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
If I look for Sheol as my home, if I spread out my bed in darkness,
For I will not accuse you forever, nor will I always be angry; for then the spirit of man would grow weak before Me— the breath of life I have made.
My breath is repulsive to my wife, and I am loathsome to my own family.

verses.text: Surely mockers surround me, and my eyes must gaze at their rebellion.

xrefs.text: My friends are my scoffers as my eyes pour out tears to God.
I am a laughingstock to my friends, though I called on God, and He answered. The righteous and upright man is a laughingstock.
Because the LORD had closed Hannah’s womb, her rival would provoke her viciously to taunt her.
And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him, shaking their heads
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.text: Give me, I pray, the pledge You demand. Who else will be my guarantor?

xrefs.text: Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
I chirp like a swallow or crane; I moan like a dove. My eyes grow weak as I look upward. O Lord, I am oppressed; be my security.”
He who puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer, but the one who hates indebtedness is secure.
I will guarantee his safety. You may hold me personally responsible. If I do not bring him back and set him before you, then may I bear the guilt before you all my life.
Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.

verses.text: You have closed their minds to understanding; therefore You will not exalt them.

xrefs.text: At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.
He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.

Then Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The advice of Hushai the Archite is better than that of Ahithophel.” For the LORD had purposed to thwart the good counsel of Ahithophel in order to bring disaster on Absalom.
The LORD has poured into her a spirit of confusion. Egypt has been led astray in all she does, as a drunkard staggers through his own vomit.
Where is the wise man? Where is the scribe? Where is the philosopher of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?

verses.text: If a man denounces his friends for a price, the eyes of his children will fail.

xrefs.text: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.
A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
He who reveals secrets is a constant gossip; avoid the one who babbles with his lips.
Nevertheless, for the sake of your father David, I will not do it during your lifetime; I will tear it out of the hand of your son.
But the eyes of the wicked will fail, and escape will elude them; they will hope for their last breath.”

verses.text: He has made me a byword among the people, a man in whose face they spit.

xrefs.text: And now they mock me in song; I have become a byword among them.
You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
Why did you run away secretly and deceive me, without even telling me? I would have sent you away with joy and singing, with tambourines and harps.

then I will cut off Israel from the land that I have given them, and I will banish from My presence this temple I have sanctified for My Name. Then Israel will become an object of scorn and ridicule among all peoples.
At their feasts are the lyre and harp, tambourines and flutes and wine. They disregard the actions of the LORD and fail to see the work of His hands.

verses.text: My eyes have grown dim with grief, and my whole body is but a shadow.

xrefs.text: My face is red with weeping, and deep shadows ring my eyes;
My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
You have bound me, and it has become a witness; my frailty rises up and testifies against me.

verses.text: The upright are appalled at this, and the innocent are stirred against the godless.

xrefs.text: If you see the oppression of the poor and the denial of justice and righteousness in the province, do not be astonished at the matter; for one official is watched by a superior, and others higher still are over them.

Your eyes are too pure to look upon evil, and You cannot tolerate wrongdoing. So why do You tolerate the faithless? Why are You silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?

Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: “It was necessary to speak the word of God to you first. But since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.
The righteous see it and are glad; the innocent mock them:
O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!

verses.text: Yet a righteous one holds to his way, and the one with clean hands grows stronger.

xrefs.text: The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until midday.
When you spread out your hands in prayer, I will hide My eyes from you; even though you multiply your prayers, I will not listen. Your hands are covered with blood.
He will deliver even one who is not innocent, rescuing him through the cleanness of your hands.”
They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.
A wise man fears and turns from evil, but a fool is careless and reckless.

verses.text: But come back and try again, all of you. For I will not find a wise man among you.

xrefs.text: Reconsider; do not be unjust. Reconsider, for my righteousness is at stake.

After the LORD had spoken these words to Job, He said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you and your two friends. For you have not spoken about Me accurately, as My servant Job has.
“Truly then you are the people with whom wisdom itself will die!
Where is the wise man? Where is the scribe? Where is the philosopher of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?
What do you know that we do not? What do you understand that is not clear to us?

verses.text: My days have passed; my plans are broken off— even the desires of my heart.

xrefs.text: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle; they come to an end without hope.
I said, “In the prime of my life I must go through the gates of Sheol and be deprived of the remainder of my years.”
A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?
Devise a plan, but it will be thwarted; state a proposal, but it will not happen. For God is with us.

verses.text: They have turned night into day, making light seem near in the face of darkness.

xrefs.text: When daylight is gone, the murderer rises to kill the poor and needy; in the night he is like a thief.
In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were evening!’ and in the evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’— because of the dread in your hearts of the terrifying sights you will see.
When I think my bed will comfort me and my couch will ease my complaint,
So I am allotted months of futility, and nights of misery are appointed to me.

verses.text: If I look for Sheol as my home, if I spread out my bed in darkness,

xrefs.text: before I go— never to return— to a land of darkness and gloom,
Yes, I know that You will bring me down to death, to the place appointed for all the living.
If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
Those who walk uprightly enter into peace; they find rest, lying down in death.
[“]My spirit is broken; my days are extinguished; the grave awaits me.

verses.text: and say to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ or ‘My sister,’

xrefs.text: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.
He is carried to the grave, and watch is kept over his tomb.
But together they lie down in the dust, and worms cover them both.
Your pomp has been brought down to Sheol, along with the music of your harps. Maggots are your bed and worms your blanket.

verses.text: where then is my hope? Who can see any hope for me?

xrefs.text: Though He slay me, I will hope in Him. I will still defend my ways to His face.
What strength do I have, that I should still hope? What is my future, that I should be patient?
Is your reverence not your confidence, and the uprightness of your ways your hope?
He tears me down on every side until I am gone; He uproots my hope like a tree.
My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle; they come to an end without hope.

verses.text: Will it go down to the gates of Sheol? Will we go down together into the dust?”

xrefs.text: There the wicked cease from raging, and there the weary find rest.
To the roots of the mountains I descended; the earth beneath me barred me in forever! But You raised my life from the pit, O LORD my God!
to preserve his soul from the Pit and his life from perishing by the sword.
Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
Surely for my own welfare I had such great anguish; but Your love has delivered me from the pit of oblivion, for You have cast all my sins behind Your back.
